svg.title: Fig. S2 Temporal roles and issue-time information boundary
svg.desc: Four panels separate temporal roles, the issue-time predictor boundary, all seven provider/source-date rules, and the equally weighted capabilities and limitations of the outcome-free 2018–2020 predictor bridge.
